fieldValues.title: The dream agent works from a container of rule records
fieldValues.move: srs-context holds a Dream rules container: one record per rule (when it applies, what the dream does, the measure that shows it helps, and a falsifier), including the rules for the shape of the tree a person browses. The dream reads the rules, cites the rule id for every change it makes, and reports per rule what it did and what the measure did. A rule changes by successor, so its history stays; dream-cycle.md becomes the rendered view of the container.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not decide which rules are right; the measures and the owner do. It does not make the navigation tree collapsible in a client (SP-83).
fieldValues.falsifier: After a month, a dream report cannot name the rule behind one of its changes, or no rule has been amended or retired because of its measure.
